name: Necromantic Tenacity
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a necromancy effect, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure on such a save, you get a failure instead.

name: Practiced Guidance
sents: When you roll a success to Aid a member of your crop, you get a critical success instead.

name: Witch Warden
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a curse or a spell cast by a witch or hag, you get a critical success instead.

name: Kneel for No God
sents: When you use your Call on Ancient Blood reaction against a divine spell and roll a critical failure on the saving throw against that spell, you get a failure instead.

name: Woodcraft
sents: When in a forest or jungle environment, if you roll a critical failure on a Survival skill check to Sense Direction, Subsist, or Cover Tracks, you get a failure instead, and if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

name: Grim Insight
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead, and the source of the fear effect is off-guard to you until the end of your next turn.

name: Adroit Manipulation
sents: If you roll a success on a Thievery check to Pick a Lock, you get a critical success instead.

name: Bravo's Determination
sents: If the triggering attack was a critical hit, use the result one degree of success worse than what you rolled.

name: Endure Death's Touch
sents: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on any saving throws against effects from the undead's natural attack; if you succeed at the saving throw, you get a critical success instead.

name: Knight Reclaimant Dedication
sents: Whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an undead's special ability, you get a critical success instead.

name: Survivor of Desolation
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Emerald Boughs Accustomation
sents: When you use the Society skill to Subsist, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead; if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead; and if you roll a critical success, you can provide for another additional creature.
Furthermore, when you attempt a Society check to Recall Knowledge about cultural practices and roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Forced Entry
sents: If you roll a success on a check to Force Open, you get a critical success instead.

name: Crystal Keeper Dedication
sents: When you Decipher Writing and roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead, and when you Decipher Writing and roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

name: Staff Acrobat Dedication
sents: Finally, when you roll a success on a check to Balance while wielding your staff, you get a critical success instead.

name: Esteemed Visitor
sents: While you are in a settlement, when you roll a critical failure on a Diplomacy check to Gather Information or Make an Impression, you get a failure instead.

name: Iron Lung
sents: Treat the result of your save against an inhaled poison as one degree of success better than you rolled.

name: Elven Aloofness
sents: If a non-elf rolls a failure on a check to Coerce you using Intimidation, it gets a critical failure instead (and thus can't try to Coerce you again for 1 week).

name: Know Your Own
sents: If you critically fail a check to Recall Knowledge about elves, elven society, or elven history, you get a failure instead.

name: Extra Squishy
sents: If you roll a success to Squeeze, you get a critical success instead.

name: Gorilla Stance
sents: While you are in Gorilla Stance, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Climb, and if you roll a success on an Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.

name: Remember Your Training
sents: If you roll a failure (but not a critical failure) on this check, you get a success instead.

name: Glyph Expert
sents: When you attempt a saving throw against the effects of these traps, if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.
If you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Ancestral Insight
sents: If you roll a critical failure on an Alghollthu Lore or Azlanti Lore check to Recall Knowledge, you get a failure instead.

name: Pelagic Aptitude
sents: When in an aquatic environment, if you roll a critical failure on a Survival skill check to Sense Direction or Subsist, you get a failure instead.

name: Hydraulic Maneuvers
sents: You don't receive any item bonuses to that check or any circumstance bonuses related to your physical body, but if you roll a critical failure on that Athletics check, you get a failure instead.

name: Adhyabhau
sents: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against effects with the emotion trait, and when you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Slither
sents: When you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to Squeeze, you get a critical success instead.

name: Emotionless
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Lightless Litheness
sents: When you critically fail at Squeezing, you get a failure instead.
Additionally, when you roll a success at an Escape check, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical success, you can Step instead of Striding up to 5 feet.

name: Steady on Stone

name: Wind Tempered

name: Tide-Hardened

name: Golden League Xun Dedication
sents: In addition, if you use Underworld Lore to Earn Income or Recall Knowledge, when you get a success, you get a critical success instead.

name: Rope Mastery

name: Web Walker

name: Goloma Courage

name: Spelunker

name: Shore Step

name: Steadying Stone

name: Unshakable Grit

name: Explosive Entry
sents: If you roll a critical success, you get a success instead.

name: Adaptive Vision
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a visual effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Fire Savvy

name: Blast Resistance

name: Rock Runner

name: Forlorn
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Unwavering Mien

name: Ancestral Suspicion
sents: When you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Reckless Abandon (Goblin)

name: Sure Feet

name: Unfettered Halfling

Whenever a creature rolls a failure on a check to Grapple you, it gets a critical failure instead.

name: Irrepressible

name: Haughty Obstinacy

name: Cooperative Soul

name: Undaunted
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Athletic Might
sents: Whenever you roll a success on an Athletics check to Climb or Swim, you get a critical success instead.

name: Brine May
sents: Whenever you roll a success on an Athletics check to Swim, you get a critical success instead.

name: Called

name: Lawbringer

name: Earned Glory

name: Raise Symbol

name: Warden's Guidance

name: Sneak Adept
sents: When you roll a failure on a Sneak action, you get a success instead.

name: Spellbook Prodigy
sents: Further, when you roll a critical failure on your check to Learn a Spell, you get a failure instead.

name: Breath Control
sents: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against inhaled threats, such as inhaled poisons, and if you roll a success on such a saving throw, you get a critical success instead.

name: Hobnobber

name: Impeccable Crafting

name: Shameless Request
sents: When you Request something, you reduce any DC increases for making an outrageous request by 2, and if you roll a critical failure for your Request, you get a failure instead.

name: Steady Balance

name: Student of the Canon

When attempting to Recall Knowledge about the tenets of your own faith, if you roll a failure, you get a success instead, and if you roll a success, you get a critical success instead.

name: Unmistakable Lore
sents: When you Recall Knowledge using any Lore subcategory in which you're trained, if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Practiced Brawn

name: Proud Mentor
sents: If you get a critical failure on an attempt to Aid, you get a failure instead.

name: Swimmer's Guidance

name: Natural Orienteering

name: Defensive Dismissal

name: Heightened Instincts

name: Well-Groomed

If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the Battle Hardened fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

name: Cantorian Reinforcement

If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the Battle Hardened fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

name: Affliction Resistance

name: Dragon's Presence
sents: When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.
When you roll a failure against a fear effect, you get a critical failure instead.

name: Marsh Runner
sents: In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to Balance on narrow surfaces or uneven marshy ground, you aren't off-guard, and if you roll a success on the Acrobatics check, you get a critical success instead.

name: Parthenogenic Hatchling
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease, you get a critical success instead.
If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the Battle Hardened fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

name: Gecko's Grip
sents: You gain the Combat Climber feat as a bonus feat, and if you roll a success on an Athletics check to climb, you get a critical success instead.

name: Warren Navigator
sents: When you Sense Direction or attempt a roll against a Quandary spell, you get a result one degree of success better than you rolled.

name: Lab Rat
sents: If you roll a success on your saving throw against a poison or disease, you get a critical success instead.

name: Jungle Strider
sents: In addition, when you use the Acrobatics skill to Balance on narrow surfaces or uneven ground made of plant material, you aren't off-guard, and when you roll a success at one of these Acrobatics checks, you get a critical success instead.

name: Necromantic Physiology
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease, you get a critical success instead.
If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the Battle Hardened fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

name: Blowgun Poisoner
sents: If you critically succeed at a blowgun Strike using a poisoned dart, the target's initial save against the poison is one degree of success worse than the creature rolls; this is a misfortune effect.

name: Divine Health
sents: In addition, if you roll a success on a save against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead.
(Your allies don't share this benefit.) If you have the Sacred Body class feature, when you roll a critical failure on a save against a disease or poison, you get a failure instead.

name: Eliminate Red Herrings

name: Assured Ritualist

sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a transmutation effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Lethoci
sents: If you critically fail an Athletics check to Swim, you get a failure instead.

name: Wajaghand Vanara
sents: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects, and whenever you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Death Warden Dwarf
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against an effect that has the void trait or was created by an undead creature, you get a critical success instead.

name: Irongut Goblin
sents: When you roll a success on a Fortitude save affected by this bonus, you get a critical success instead.

name: Gutsy Halfling
sents: When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Vine Leshy
sents: Additionally, if you roll a success on an Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.

name: Runtboss Hobgoblin
sents: If you roll a success on an Intimidation check to Coerce a goblin, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Warrenbred Hobgoblin
sents: In addition, if you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to Squeeze, you get a critical success instead.

name: Cavernstalker Kobold
sents: If you roll a success on an Acrobatics check to Squeeze, you get a critical success instead.

name: Cliffscale Lizardfolk
sents: Additionally, if you roll a success on an Athletics check to climb, you get a critical success instead.

name: Sewer Rat
sents: If you roll a success on a saving throw against a disease or poison, you get a critical success instead.
If you have a different ability that would improve the save in this way (such as the Battle Hardened fighter class feature), if you roll a critical failure on the save you get a failure instead.

name: Jinxed Tengu
sents: If you succeed at a saving throw against a curse or misfortune effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Stickytoe Tripkee
sents: When ascending trees, vines, and other foliage, if you roll a success on the Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.

name: Dragonblood
sents: When you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Kijimuna Gnome
sents: You gain the Combat Climber feat, and if you roll a success on the Athletics check to Climb, you get a critical success instead.

name: Heavenscribe Kobold
sents: Whenever you critically fail a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression or Request, you get a failure instead.

name: Dijiang
sents: When you roll a failure (though not a critical failure) on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a success instead.

name: Even-tempered Tanuki
sents: If you roll a success at a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead, but when you roll a failure at a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical failure instead.

name: Born of Item
sents: If you roll a success on a mental effect, you gain a critical success instead.

name: Nocturnal Navigator
sents: Whenever you can clearly identify the stars, if you roll a success on a check to Sense Direction or otherwise orienteer, you get a critical success instead; if you roll a critical failure at such a check, you get a failure instead.
